monsters.name: Invisible Stalker
monsters.facts: Large Elemental, Neutral. Skills Perception +8, Stealth +10. Resistances Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing. Immunities Poison. Senses Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 18. Languages Common, Primordial (Auran). XP 2300; Proficiency Bonus +3.

actions.name: Air Form
actions.text: The stalker can enter an enemy’s space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.text: The stalker has the Invisible condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The stalker makes three Wind Swipe attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Vortex.

actions.name: Wind Swipe
actions.text: (melee, reach 5 ft.)

actions.name: Vortex
actions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, one Large or smaller creature in the stalker’s space. Failure: 7 (1d8 + 3) Thunder damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). Until the grapple ends, the target can’t cast spells with a Verbal component and takes 7 (2d6) Thunder damage at the start of each of the stalker’s turns.

monsters.name: Iron Golem
monsters.facts: Large Construct, Unaligned. Immunities Fire, Poison, Psychic. Senses Darkvision 120 ft., Passive Perception 10. Languages Understands Common plus two other languages but can’t speak. XP 15000; Proficiency Bonus +5.

actions.name: Fire Absorption
actions.text: Whenever the golem is subjected to Fire damage, it regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Fire damage dealt.

actions.name: Immutable Form
actions.text: The golem can’t shape-shift.

actions.name: Magic Resistance
actions.text: The golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The golem makes two attacks, using Bladed Arm or Fiery Bolt in any combination.

actions.name: Bladed Arm
actions.text: (melee, reach 10 ft.) plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage

actions.name: Fiery Bolt
actions.text: (ranged, range 120 ft.)

actions.name: Poison Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. Failure: 55 (10d10) Poison damage. Success: Half damage.

monsters.name: Knight
monsters.facts: Medium or small Humanoid, Neutral. Saving throws CON +4, WIS +2. Gear Greatsword, Heavy Crossbow, Plate Armor. Senses Passive Perception 10. Languages Common plus one other language. XP 700; Proficiency Bonus +2.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The knight makes two attacks, using Greatsword or Heavy Crossbow in any combination.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.text: (melee, reach 5 ft.) plus 4 (1d8) Radiant damage

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.text: (ranged, range 100/400 ft.) plus 4 (1d8) Radiant damage

actions.name: Parry
actions.text: Trigger: The knight is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The knight adds 2 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

monsters.name: Kobold Warrior
monsters.facts: Small Dragon, Neutral. Gear Daggers (3). Senses Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 8. Languages Common, Draconic. XP 25; Proficiency Bonus +2.

actions.name: Pack Tactics
actions.text: The kobold has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
actions.text: While in sunlight, the kobold has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.text: (melee or ranged, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft.)

monsters.name: Kraken
monsters.facts: Gargantuan Monstrosity, Chaotic Evil. Saving throws STR +17, DEX +7, CON +15, WIS +11. Skills History +13, Perception +11. Immunities Cold, Lightning. Senses Truesight 120 ft., Passive Perception 21. Languages Understands Abyssal, Celestial, Infernal, and Primordial but can’t speak; telepathy 120 ft.. XP 50000, or 62000 in lair; Proficiency Bonus +7.

actions.name: Amphibious
actions.text: The kraken can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
actions.text: If the kraken fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Siege Monster
actions.text: The kraken deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The kraken makes two Tentacle attacks and uses Fling, Lightning Strike, or Swallow.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.text: (melee, reach 30 ft.). The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 20) from one of ten tentacles, and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends

actions.name: Fling
actions.text: The kraken throws a Large or smaller creature Grappled by it to a space it can see within 60 feet of itself that isn’t in the air. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 25, the creature thrown and each creature in the destination space. Failure: 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Lightning Strike
actions.text: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 23, one creature the kraken can see within 120 feet. Failure: 33 (6d10) Lightning damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.text: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 25, one creature Grappled by the kraken (it can have up to four creatures swallowed at a time). Failure: 23 (3d8 + 10) Piercing damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it is swallowed and no longer Grappled. A swallowed creature has the Restrained condition, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the kraken, and takes 24 (7d6) Acid damage at the start of each of its turns. If the kraken takes 50 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the kraken must succeed on a DC 25 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the kraken with the Prone condition. If the kraken dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

actions.name: Storm Bolt
actions.text: The kraken uses Lightning Strike.

actions.name: Toxic Ink
actions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 23, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the kraken while it is underwater. Failure: The target has the Blinded and Poisoned conditions until the end of the kraken’s next turn. The kraken then moves up to its Speed. Failure or Success: The kraken can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

monsters.name: Lamia
monsters.facts: Large Fiend, Chaotic Evil. Skills Deception +7, Insight +4, Stealth +5. Senses Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 12. Languages Abyssal, Common. XP 1100; Proficiency Bonus +2.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The lamia makes two Claw attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Corrupting Touch.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: (melee, reach 5 ft.) plus 7 (2d6) Psychic damage

actions.name: Corrupting Touch
actions.text: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 13, one creature the lamia can see within 5 feet. Failure: 13 (3d8) Psychic damage, and the target is cursed for 1 hour. Until the curse ends, the target has the Charmed and Poisoned conditions.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The lamia casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13): At will: Disguise Self, Minor Illusion; 1/Day each: Geas, Major Image, Scrying.

actions.name: Leap
actions.text: The lamia jumps up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.

monsters.name: Lemure
monsters.facts: Medium Fiend, Lawful Evil. Resistances Cold. Immunities Fire, Poison. Senses Darkvision 120 ft. (unimpeded by magical darkness), Passive Perception 10. Languages Understands Infernal but can’t speak. XP 10; Proficiency Bonus +2.

actions.name: Hellish Restoration
actions.text: If the lemure dies in the Nine Hells, it revives with all its Hit Points in 1d10 days unless it is killed by a creature under the effects of a Bless spell or its remains are sprinkled with Holy Water.

actions.name: Vile Slime
actions.text: (melee, reach 5 ft.)

monsters.name: Lich
monsters.facts: Medium Undead, Neutral Evil. Saving throws DEX +10, CON +10, INT +12, WIS +9. Skills Arcana +19, History +12, Insight +9, Perception +9. Resistances Cold, Lightning. Immunities Necrotic, Poison. Gear Component Pouch. Senses Truesight 120 ft., Passive Perception 19. Languages All. XP 33000, or 41000 in lair; Proficiency Bonus +7.

actions.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
actions.text: If the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Spirit Jar
actions.text: If destroyed, the lich reforms in 1d10 days if it has a spirit jar, reviving with all its Hit Points. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within the lich’s lair.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The lich makes three attacks, using Eldritch Burst or Paralyzing Touch in any combination.

actions.name: Eldritch Burst
actions.text: (melee or ranged, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft.)

actions.name: Paralyzing Touch
actions.text: (melee, reach 5 ft.) and the target has the Paralyzed condition until the start of the lich’s next turn

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The lich casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20): At will: Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Dispel Magic, Fireball, Invisibility, Lightning Bolt, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation; 2/Day each: Animate Dead, Dimension Door, Plane Shift; 1/Day each: Chain Lightning, Finger of Death, Power Word Kill, Scrying.

actions.name: Protective Magic
actions.text: The lich casts Counterspell or Shield in response to the spell’s trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

actions.name: Deathly Teleport
actions.text: The lich teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, and each creature within 10 feet of the space it left takes 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Disrupt Life
actions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20, each creature that isn’t an Undead in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the lich. Failure: 31 (9d6) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: The lich can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Frightening Gaze
actions.text: The lich casts Fear, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. The lich can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

monsters.name: Mage
monsters.facts: Medium or small Humanoid, Neutral. Saving throws INT +6, WIS +4. Skills Arcana +6, History +6, Perception +4. Gear Wand. Senses Passive Perception 14. Languages Common plus three other languages. XP 2300; Proficiency Bonus +3.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The mage makes three Arcane Burst attacks.

actions.name: Arcane Burst
actions.text: (melee or ranged, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft.)

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The mage casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14): At will: Detect Magic, Light, Mage Armor, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation; 2/Day each: Fireball, Invisibility; 1/Day each: Cone of Cold, Fly.

actions.name: Misty Step (3/Day)
actions.text: The mage casts Misty Step, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

actions.name: Protective Magic (3/Day)
actions.text: The mage casts Counterspell or Shield in response to the spell’s trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

monsters.name: Archmage
monsters.facts: Medium or small Humanoid, Neutral. Saving throws INT +9, WIS +6. Skills Arcana +13, History +9, Perception +6. Immunities Psychic. Gear Wand. Senses Passive Perception 16. Languages Common plus five other languages. XP 8000; Proficiency Bonus +4.

actions.name: Magic Resistance
actions.text: The archmage has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The archmage makes four Arcane Burst attacks.

actions.name: Arcane Burst
actions.text: (melee or ranged, reach 5 ft. or range 150 ft.)

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The archmage casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17): At will: Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Disguise Self, Invisibility, Light, Mage Armor, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation; 2/Day each: Fly, Lightning Bolt; 1/Day each: Cone of Cold, Mind Blank, Scrying, Teleport.

actions.name: Misty Step (3/Day)
actions.text: The mage casts Misty Step, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

actions.name: Protective Magic (3/Day)
actions.text: The archmage casts Counterspell or Shield in response to the spell’s trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

monsters.name: Magmin
monsters.facts: Small Elemental, Chaotic Neutral. Immunities Fire. Senses Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 10. Languages Primordial (Ignan). XP 100; Proficiency Bonus +2.

actions.name: Death Burst
actions.text: The magmin explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the magmin. Failure: 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Touch
actions.text: (melee, reach 5 ft.). If the target is a creature or a flammable object that isn’t being worn or carried, it starts burning

actions.name: Ignited Illumination
actions.text: The magmin sets itself ablaze or extinguishes its flames. While ablaze, the magmin sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.

monsters.name: Manticore
monsters.facts: Large Monstrosity, Lawful Evil. Senses Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 11. Languages Common. XP 700; Proficiency Bonus +2.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The manticore makes three attacks, using Rend or Tail Spike in any combination.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: (melee, reach 5 ft.)

actions.name: Tail Spike
actions.text: (ranged, range 100/200 ft.)

monsters.name: Marilith
monsters.facts: Large Fiend, Chaotic Evil. Saving throws STR +9, CON +10, WIS +8, CHA +10. Skills Perception +8. Resistances Cold, Fire, Lightning. Immunities Poison. Senses Truesight 120 ft., Passive Perception 18. Languages Abyssal; telepathy 120 ft.. XP 15000; Proficiency Bonus +5.

actions.name: Demonic Restoration
actions.text: If the marilith dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

actions.name: Magic Resistance
actions.text: The marilith has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Reactive
actions.text: The marilith can take one Reaction on every turn of combat.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The marilith makes six Pact Blade attacks and uses Constrict.

actions.name: Pact Blade
actions.text: (melee, reach 5 ft.) plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage

actions.name: Constrict
actions.text: Strength Saving Throw: DC 17, one Medium or smaller creature the marilith can see within 5 feet. Failure: 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

actions.name: Teleport (Recharge 5-6)
actions.text: The marilith teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

actions.name: Parry
actions.text: Trigger: The marilith is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The marilith adds 5 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

monsters.name: Medusa
monsters.facts: Medium Monstrosity, Lawful Evil. Saving throws WIS +4. Skills Deception +5, Perception +4, Stealth +6. Senses Darkvision 150 ft., Passive Perception 14. Languages Common plus one other language. XP 2300; Proficiency Bonus +3.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The medusa makes two Claw attacks and one Snake Hair attack, or it makes three Poison Ray attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: (melee, reach 5 ft.)

actions.name: Snake Hair
actions.text: (melee, reach 5 ft.) plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage

actions.name: Poison Ray
actions.text: (ranged, range 150 ft.)

actions.name: Petrifying Gaze (Recharge 5-6)
actions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. If the medusa sees its reflection in the Cone, the medusa must make this save. First Failure: The target has the Restrained condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. Second Failure: The target has the Petrified condition instead of the Restrained condition.

monsters.name: Dust Mephit
monsters.facts: Small Elemental, Neutral Evil. Skills Perception +2, Stealth +4. Vulnerabilities Fire. Immunities Poison. Senses Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 12. Languages Primordial (Auran, Terran). XP 100; Proficiency Bonus +2.

actions.name: Death Burst
actions.text: The mephit explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the mephit. Failure: 5 (2d4) Bludgeoning damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: (melee, reach 5 ft.)

actions.name: Blinding Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.text: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: The target has the Blinded condition until the end of the mephit’s next turn.

actions.name: Sleep (1/Day)
actions.text: The mephit casts the Sleep spell, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 10).

monsters.name: Ice Mephit
monsters.facts: Small Elemental, Neutral Evil. Skills Perception +2, Stealth +3. Vulnerabilities Fire. Immunities Cold, Poison. Senses Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 12. Languages Primordial (Aquan, Auran). XP 100; Proficiency Bonus +2.

actions.name: Death Burst
actions.text: The mephit explodes when it dies. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the mephit. Failure: 5 (2d4) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: (melee, reach 5 ft.) plus 2 (1d4) Cold damage

actions.name: Fog Cloud (1/Day)
actions.text: The mephit casts Fog Cloud, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.

actions.name: Frost Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 7 (3d4) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.

monsters.name: Magma Mephit
monsters.facts: Small Elemental, Neutral Evil. Skills Stealth +3. Vulnerabilities Cold. Immunities Fire, Poison. Senses Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 10. Languages Primordial (Ignan, Terran). XP 100; Proficiency Bonus +2.

actions.name: Death Burst
actions.text: The mephit explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the mephit. Failure: 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: (melee, reach 5 ft.) plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.text: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

monsters.name: Steam Mephit
monsters.facts: Small Elemental, Neutral Evil. Skills Stealth +2. Immunities Fire, Poison. Senses Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 10. Languages Primordial (Aquan, Ignan). XP 50; Proficiency Bonus +2.

actions.name: Blurred Form
actions.text: Attack rolls against the mephit are made with Disadvantage unless the mephit has the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Death Burst
actions.text: The mephit explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the mephit. Failure: 5 (2d4) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: (melee, reach 5 ft.) plus 2 (1d4) Fire damage

actions.name: Steam Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 5 (2d4) Fire damage, and the target’s Speed decreases by 10 feet until the end of the mephit’s next turn. Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: Being underwater doesn’t grant Resistance to this Fire damage.

monsters.name: Merfolk Skirmisher
monsters.facts: Medium Elemental, Neutral. Senses Passive Perception 12. Languages Common, Primordial (Aquan). XP 25; Proficiency Bonus +2.

actions.name: Amphibious
actions.text: The merfolk can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Ocean Spear
actions.text: (melee or ranged, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft.) plus 2 (1d4) Cold damage. If the target is a creature, its Speed decreases by 10 feet until the end of its next turn. Hit or Miss: The spear magically returns to the merfolk’s hand immediately after a ranged attack

monsters.name: Merrow
monsters.facts: Large Monstrosity, Chaotic Evil. Senses Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 10. Languages Abyssal, Primordial (Aquan). XP 450; Proficiency Bonus +2.

actions.name: Amphibious
actions.text: The merrow can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The merrow makes two attacks, using Bite, Claw, or Harpoon in any combination.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: (melee, reach 5 ft.) and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of the merrow’s next turn

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: (melee, reach 5 ft.)

actions.name: Harpoon
actions.text: (melee or ranged, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft.). If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the merrow pulls the target up to 15 feet straight toward itself

monsters.name: Mimic
monsters.facts: Medium Monstrosity, Neutral. Skills Stealth +5. Immunities Acid. Senses Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 11. Languages None. XP 450; Proficiency Bonus +2.

actions.name: Adhesive (Object Form Only)
actions.text: The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mimic has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have Disadvantage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: (melee, reach 5 ft.; with Advantage if the target is Grappled by the mimic) —or 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage if the target is Grappled by the mimic—plus 4 (1d8) Acid damage

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.text: (melee, reach 5 ft.) plus 4 (1d8) Acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have Disadvantage

actions.name: Shape-Shift
actions.text: The mimic shape-shifts to resemble a Medium or Small object while retaining its game statistics, or it returns to its true blob form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed.

monsters.name: Minotaur of Baphomet
monsters.facts: Large Monstrosity, Chaotic Evil. Skills Perception +7, Survival +7. Senses Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 17. Languages Abyssal. XP 700; Proficiency Bonus +2.

actions.name: Abyssal Glaive
actions.text: (melee, reach 10 ft.) plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage

actions.name: Gore (Recharge 5-6)
actions.text: (melee, reach 5 ft.). If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the minotaur moved 10+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition

monsters.name: Mummy
monsters.facts: Medium or small Undead, Lawful Evil. Saving throws WIS +3. Vulnerabilities Fire. Immunities Necrotic, Poison. Senses Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 11. Languages Common plus two other languages. XP 700; Proficiency Bonus +2.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The mummy makes two Rotting Fist attacks and uses Dreadful Glare.

actions.name: Rotting Fist
actions.text: (melee, reach 5 ft.) plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target can’t regain Hit Points, its Hit Point maximum doesn’t return to normal when finishing a Long Rest, and its Hit Point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) every 24 hours that elapse. A creature dies and turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack

actions.name: Dreadful Glare
actions.text: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, one creature the mummy can see within 60 feet. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the end of the mummy’s next turn. Success: The target is immune to this mummy’s Dreadful Glare for 24 hours.

monsters.name: Mummy Lord
monsters.facts: Medium or small Undead, Lawful Evil. Saving throws INT +5, WIS +9. Skills History +5, Perception +9, Religion +5. Vulnerabilities Fire. Immunities Necrotic, Poison. Senses Truesight 60 ft., Passive Perception 19. Languages Common plus three other languages. XP 13000, or 15000 in lair; Proficiency Bonus +5.

actions.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
actions.text: If the mummy fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Magic Resistance
actions.text: The mummy has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Undead Restoration
actions.text: If destroyed, the mummy gains a new body in 24 hours if its heart is intact, reviving with all its Hit Points. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within the mummy’s lair. The heart is a Tiny object that has AC 17, HP 10, and Immunity to all damage except Fire.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The mummy makes one Rotting Fist or Channel Negative Energy attack, and it uses Dreadful Glare.

actions.name: Rotting Fist
actions.text: (melee, reach 5 ft.) plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target can’t regain Hit Points, it gains no benefit from finishing a Long Rest, and its Hit Point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) every 24 hours that elapse. A creature dies and turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack

actions.name: Channel Negative Energy
actions.text: (ranged, range 60 ft.)

actions.name: Dreadful Glare
actions.text: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature the mummy can see within 60 feet. Failure: 25 (6d6 + 4) Psychic damage, and the target has the Paralyzed condition until the end of the mummy’s next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The mummy casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks): At will: Dispel Magic, Thaumaturgy; 1/Day each: Animate Dead, Harm, Insect Plague.

actions.name: Whirlwind of Sand
actions.text: Trigger: The mummy is hit by an attack roll. Response: The mummy adds 2 to its AC against the attack, possibly causing the attack to miss, and the mummy teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Each creature of its choice that it can see within 5 feet of its destination space has the Blinded condition until the end of the mummy’s next turn.

actions.name: Dread Command
actions.text: The mummy casts Command (level 2 version), using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. The mummy can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Glare
actions.text: The mummy uses Dreadful Glare. The mummy can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Necrotic Strike
actions.text: The mummy makes one Rotting Fist or Channel Negative Energy attack.

monsters.name: Nalfeshnee
monsters.facts: Large Fiend, Chaotic Evil. Saving throws CON +11, INT +9, WIS +6, CHA +7. Resistances Cold, Fire, Lightning. Immunities Poison. Senses Truesight 120 ft., Passive Perception 11. Languages Abyssal; telepathy 120 ft.. XP 10000; Proficiency Bonus +5.

actions.name: Demonic Restoration
actions.text: If the nalfeshnee dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

actions.name: Magic Resistance
actions.text: The nalfeshnee has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The nalfeshnee makes three Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: (melee, reach 10 ft.) plus 11 (2d10) Force damage

actions.name: Teleport
actions.text: The nalfeshnee teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

actions.name: Horror Nimbus (Recharge 5-6)
actions.text: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the nalfeshnee. Failure: 28 (8d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition for 1 minute, until it takes damage, or until it ends its turn with the nalfeshnee out of line of sight. Success: The target is immune to this nalfeshnee’s Horror Nimbus for 24 hours.

actions.name: Pursuit
actions.text: Trigger: Another creature the nalfeshnee can see ends its move within 120 feet of the nalfeshnee. Response: The nalfeshnee uses Teleport, but its destination space must be within 10 feet of the triggering creature.

monsters.name: Night Hag
monsters.facts: Medium Fiend, Neutral Evil. Skills Deception +6, Insight +5, Perception +5, Stealth +5. Resistances Cold, Fire. Senses Darkvision 120 ft., Passive Perception 15. Languages Abyssal, Common, Infernal, Primordial. XP 1800; Proficiency Bonus +3.

actions.name: Coven Magic
actions.text: While within 30 feet of at least two hag allies, the hag can cast one of the following spells, requiring no Material components, using the spell’s normal casting time, and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14): Augury, Find Familiar, Identify, Locate Object, Scrying, or Unseen Servant. The hag must finish a Long Rest before using this trait to cast that spell again.

actions.name: Magic Resistance
actions.text: The hag has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Soul Bag
actions.text: The hag has a soul bag. While holding or carrying the bag, the hag can use its Nightmare Haunting action. The bag has AC 15, HP 20, and Resistance to all damage. The bag turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points. If the bag is destroyed, any souls the bag is holding are released. The hag can create a new bag after 7 days.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The hag makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: (melee, reach 5 ft.)

actions.name: Nightmare Haunting (Requires Soul Bag) (1/Day)
actions.text: While on the Ethereal Plane, the hag casts Dream, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. Only the hag can serve as the spell’s messenger, and the target must be a creature the hag can see on the Material Plane. The spell fails and is wasted if the target is under the effect of the Protection from Evil and Good spell or within a Magic Circle spell. If the target takes damage from the Dream spell, the target’s Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to that damage. If the spell kills the target, its soul is trapped in the hag’s soul bag, and the target can’t be raised from the dead until its soul is released.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The hag casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14): At will: Detect Magic, Etherealness, Magic Missile; 2/Day each: Phantasmal Killer, Plane Shift.

actions.name: Shape-Shift
actions.text: The hag shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid, or it returns to its true form. Other than its size, its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed.

monsters.name: Nightmare
monsters.facts: Large Fiend, Neutral Evil. Immunities Fire. Senses Passive Perception 11. Languages Understands Abyssal, Common, and Infernal but can’t speak. XP 700; Proficiency Bonus +2.

actions.name: Confer Fire Resistance
actions.text: The nightmare can grant Resistance to Fire damage to a rider while it is on the nightmare.

actions.name: Illumination
actions.text: The nightmare sheds Bright Light in a 10foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.text: (melee, reach 5 ft.) plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage

actions.name: Ethereal Stride
actions.text: The nightmare and up to three willing creatures within 5 feet of it teleport to the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane or vice versa.

monsters.name: Noble
monsters.facts: Medium or small Humanoid, Neutral. Skills Deception +5, Insight +4, Persuasion +5. Gear Breastplate, Rapier. Senses Passive Perception 12. Languages Common plus two other languages. XP 25; Proficiency Bonus +2.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.text: (melee, reach 5 ft.)

actions.name: Parry
actions.text: Trigger: The noble is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The noble adds 2 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

monsters.name: Ochre Jelly
monsters.facts: Large Ooze, Unaligned. Resistances Acid. Immunities Lightning, Slashing. Senses Blindsight 60 ft., Passive Perception 8. Languages None. XP 450; Proficiency Bonus +2.

actions.name: Amorphous
actions.text: The jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

actions.name: Spider Climb
actions.text: The jelly can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.text: (melee, reach 5 ft.)

actions.name: Split
actions.text: Trigger: While the jelly is Large or Medium and has 10+ Hit Points, it becomes Bloodied or is subjected to Lightning or Slashing damage. Response: The jelly splits into two new Ochre Jellies. Each new jelly is one size smaller than the original jelly and acts on its Initiative. The original jelly’s Hit Points are divided evenly between the new jellies (round down).

monsters.name: Ogre
monsters.facts: Large Giant, Chaotic Evil. Gear Greatclub, Javelins (3). Senses Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 8. Languages Common, Giant. XP 450; Proficiency Bonus +2.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.text: (melee, reach 5 ft.)

actions.name: Javelin
actions.text: (melee or ranged, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft.)

monsters.name: Oni

actions.name: Regeneration
actions.text: The oni regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The oni makes two Claw or Nightmare Ray attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: (melee, reach 10 ft.) plus 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage

actions.name: Nightmare Ray
actions.text: (ranged, range 60 ft.) and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the oni’s next turn

actions.name: Shape-Shift
actions.text: The oni shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid or a Large Giant, or it returns to its true form. Other than its size, its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The oni casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13): 1/Day each: Charm Person, Darkness, Gaseous Form, Sleep.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.text: The oni casts Invisibility on itself, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

monsters.name: Otyugh
monsters.facts: Large Aberration, Neutral. Saving throws CON +7. Senses Darkvision 120 ft., Passive Perception 11. Languages Otyugh; telepathy 120 ft. (doesn’t allow the receiving creature to respond telepathically). XP 1800; Proficiency Bonus +3.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The otyugh makes one Bite attack and two Tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: (melee, reach 5 ft.) and the target has the Poisoned condition. Whenever the Poisoned target finishes a Long Rest, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The target’s Hit Point maximum decreases by 5 (1d10) and doesn’t return to normal until the Poisoned condition ends on the target. Success: The Poisoned condition ends

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.text: (melee, reach 10 ft.). If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13) from one of two tentacles

actions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature Grappled by the otyugh. Failure: 16 (3d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the start of the otyugh’s next turn. Success: Half damage only.

monsters.name: Owlbear

actions.name: Divine Awareness

actions.name: Magic Resistance
actions.text: The planetar has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The planetar makes three Radiant Sword attacks or uses Holy Burst twice.

actions.name: Radiant Sword
actions.text: (melee, reach 10 ft.) plus 18 (4d8) Radiant damage

actions.name: Holy Burst
actions.text: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 20, each enemy in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the planetar can see within 120 feet. Failure: 24 (7d6) Radiant damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The planetar casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20): At will: Detect Evil and Good; 1/Day each: Commune, Control Weather, Dispel Evil and Good, Raise Dead.

actions.name: Divine Aid (2/Day)
actions.text: The planetar casts Cure Wounds, Invisibility, Lesser Restoration, or Remove Curse, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

monsters.name: Priest Acolyte

actions.text: (melee, reach 5 ft.) plus 2 (1d4) Radiant damage

actions.name: Radiant Flame
actions.text: (ranged, range 60 ft.)

monsters.name: Priest
monsters.facts: Medium or small Humanoid, Neutral. Skills Medicine +7, Perception +5, Religion +5. Gear Chain Shirt, Holy Symbol, Mace. Senses Passive Perception 15. Languages Common plus one other language. XP 450; Proficiency Bonus +2.

actions.name: Magic Resistance

actions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12, one creature the pseudodragon can see within 5 feet. Failure: 5 (2d4) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition for 1 hour. Failure by 5 or More: While Poisoned, the target also has the Unconscious condition, which ends early if the target takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it.

monsters.name: Purple Worm
monsters.facts: Gargantuan Monstrosity, Unaligned. Saving throws CON +11, WIS +4. Senses Blindsight 30 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft., Passive Perception 9. Languages None. XP 13000; Proficiency Bonus +5.

actions.name: Tunneler

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The worm makes one Bite attack and one Tail Stinger attack.

actions.name: Bite

actions.name: Tail Stinger

If the worm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the worm must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 5 feet of the worm and has the Prone condition.
